record.nl_statement: For any natural number n, the sum of the first n odd numbers equals n squared.
record.expected_lean_statement: theorem sum_odd_sq (n : ℕ) : (Finset.range n).sum (fun i => 2 * i + 1) = n ^ 2

curation.family_review_note: Finite sum identity over a natural-number range.
